rejections.refuting_row: 4x4.C1 (UNTESTED, CLAIMS.md §2.3: 'SUPPORTED, not PROVEN; no exhaustive ground truth exists')
rejections.rationale: The T335 proposal to promote 4x4.C1 to CLAIMED on the strength of G3b pass0 is rejected on the sprint owner's own ruling: docs/epic-01-markovian/sprints/g3b-value-correctness/pass0/accept.md §6 (Orchestrator, 2026-08-05) states 'G3b is NOT discharged, and no claim is promoted'. C-A1/C-A2 closure was tabled as PASS with no denominator — the 4x4 evidence is a 22-entry sample out of 99,133,036 (0.00002%), the exact defect the g3b spec was written to prevent (§2.1: a check that cannot fail is not a check); the four remaining gaps are registered as T363. Internal consistency (0 Bellman violations, 0 key mismatches, 0 move-set mismatches) is not correctness against ground truth, which is what 4x4.C1 asserts and what the row marks UNTESTED.

rejections.refuting_row: 4x4.FP1 (UNTESTED — checks 1-2; check 3 PASSES, CLAIMS.md §2.2) and 4x4.FP1-C1/4x4.FP1-C2 (UNTESTED, CLAIMS.md §2.2)
rejections.rationale: The T335 proposal to promote 4x4.FP1 to CLAIMED is rejected: the register row 4x4.FP1 remains UNTESTED for checks 1-2 (seed from -N/+N, zero-change termination) per CLAIMS.md §2.2 and 4x4/EPISTEMIC.md:69-97; only check 3 (V0/V1 Bellman identities, 4x4.FP1-C3) is PROVEN as scoped. The I4 Bellman-residual result from G3b pass0 covers the check-3 class, not seeding/termination. The g3b sprint owner's ruling (pass0/accept.md §6, 2026-08-05) states no claim is promoted from G3b pass0; I5 containment is deferred to T344 and does not discharge FP1 checks 1-2. Internal-consistency measurement is not fixpoint-seeding evidence.
